rules.condition: service contract with estimated value above the Goods & Services Threshold
rules.threshold_text: exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: consider and record how the procurement could improve economic, social and environmental wellbeing (Social Value Act 2012, Social Value Policy)
rules.verbatim_quote: consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire

rules.required_action: contract must rest on a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision maker under the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or under the Scheme of Delegation an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate
rules.evidence_detail: Decision record / delegation authorising each contract
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.required_action: contract must be covered by an existing budgetary provision in the Council-approved Budget
rules.approver: the Council (approved Budget)
rules.evidence_detail: Budget provision / cost-centre approval for the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.required_action: treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council
rules.approver: Key Decision of the Council
rules.evidence_detail: Forward Plan / Key Decision record; awarded values in contracts.csv
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.required_action: publish the expenditure, including payments to suppliers and contractors (Transparency Code 2015)
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for a goods/services contract valued over £5,000
rules.required_action: publish details of the invitation to tender
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts in progress or awarded
rules.required_action: publish a contracts register with value, duration and supplier
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.required_action: report contract information to the relevant board monthly
rules.evidence_detail: Monthly contract reports to the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis

rules.required_action: check that the awarded supplier meets minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing
rules.evidence_detail: Supplier due-diligence / selection checks on the procurement file
rules.verbatim_quote: ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing

rules.required_action: advertise electronically on the Council's Procurement Portal so it also appears on the CDP
rules.evidence_detail: Procurement Portal advert record; matching notice
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities being advertised by the relevant Service Director should be done so electronically on the Council's Procurement Portal

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold
rules.threshold_text: above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds

rules.evidence_detail: CDP notice publication date vs other adverts
rules.verbatim_quote: must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium

rules.required_action: CDP notice approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or delegate
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate

rules.required_action: do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.evidence_detail: Split-purchase and threshold-clustering tests on spend workbooks; procurement files
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: repeat or similar purchases individually below the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: seek advice on whether the Procurement Legislation applies to the aggregated purchases
rules.evidence_detail: Repeat payments to one supplier in spend data; record of procurement advice
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers responsible for such procurement should therefore seek advice on the application of the Procurement Legislation where they envisage that they may be required to make such purchases.

rules.condition: contract with estimated value above the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: issue an electronic Invitation to Tender; tenders submitted electronically via the Procurement Portal
rules.evidence_detail: Portal ITT and electronic tender submissions
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold

rules.required_action: specify tender format; store tenders in a secure portal account locked until the opening time
rules.verbatim_quote: such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening

rules.condition: tender received after the opening time

rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.evidence_detail: Portal receipt timestamps; Monitoring Officer decision on late tenders

rules.required_action: tender opening conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.required_action: evaluate against criteria notified in advance to bidders
rules.evidence_detail: RFQ/ITT evaluation criteria and evaluation record
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.required_action: award on most advantageous / best value basis (not lowest price only), unless exceptional circumstances were approved in advance

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold

notes.text: No Threshold figure is printed anywhere in the Rules; 1.4, 6.5 and the App B *** footnote defer the values to the Procurement intranet, which is not in data/. Every rule bounded by a Threshold parameter cannot be tested until the auditor supplies the figures with a source.
notes.quote: published on the Procurement Intranet page

notes.text: The document header reads 'Part []': the Part number of the Constitution is left blank.
1.6.1 and 1.6.2 are numbered as sub-clauses but continue the bullet list under 1.6; 1.6.2 also brings grants to external organisations within 'entering a contract'.

6.2 ranks the Procurement Legislation first and then intranet guidance (6.1.6) above the Constitution and these Rules (6.1.3). Read literally, intranet guidance overrides the Rules; treated as background only.
5.2 and 5.2.1 are items of the Transparency Code list introduced by 5.1 and should be 5.1.2 and 5.1.3; 5.3 then follows with 'therefore'. Rules keep the printed numbers.

5.2 requires publishing details of every invitation to tender for goods/services over £5,000, but App B row A says no advertising is mandated from £1,000 to £25,000. The two can be read together (publish details vs advertise), but the obligation for £5,000-£25,000 tenders is unclear.
6.11 refers to 'tenderers from other member states', EU-era wording that no longer fits UK procurement law after PA2023.
'Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders' is a section heading printed as clause 6.23.

6.15 says Total Contract Value includes Value Added Tax, but App B bands are 'Total Value exclusive of VAT'. Spend data 'Net amount' is ex-VAT, so App B testing uses net values; App A and 4.3 bands may differ by 20% depending on which reading applies.
7.2.2 lets the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive except a contract from competition, while 7.3 says only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or exception.
'more than £24,999.99' is written as threshold_low 25000 inclusive: the same band as '£25,000 or more' at penny resolution.
'up to the Threshold' and 'up to £500,000' are read as inclusive upper bounds.

notes.clause: 6.19 / 7.4.1 / 9.1 / 11.11 / App B rows C-D / App C row E / App C note
notes.text: Unqualified 'the Threshold' and 'the appropriate Threshold' are mapped to THRESHOLD_RELEVANT, resolved by the contract's scope; 1.4 defines 'Threshold' as the relevant threshold by contract type.
7.4.2 is garbled ('Executive Director provided and an exception report') and its urgency carve-out says 'unless 7.3 applies', but 7.3 says nothing about urgency (urgency is 7.2.1).

Where the relevant Threshold exceeds £500,000 (works, concessions, light touch, as App B row C assumes), 7.4.1 (up to Threshold: S.151 alone) and 7.4.3 (over £500,000: Executive) overlap, and the 7.4.2 band is empty.
The submitter list reads 'relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director', naming Service Director twice.
'All contracts ... as detailed in Appendix B' is read as every contract in an Appendix B band (above £1,000); the clause sets no threshold of its own, so bounds are left null.
The bond-form and no-bond rules carry the 11.2 condition (works or time-bound supply estimated over £500,000), so they take its threshold.
11.5.3 has no main verb for the Service Director ('in consultation with ... who must ensure the contractor's status') and refers to the 'Inland Revenue' (now HMRC).
The sealing rule lists goods, services, works and concession contracts above Threshold but omits light touch contracts.
'up to relevant Threshold' is read as an inclusive upper bound.
A contract of exactly £500,000 falls in neither App A row 2 ('less than £500,000') nor row 3 ('Above £500,000'), and is not a Key Decision under 4.3 ('over £500,000').

The band is headed '£2.5million or more' but the text says 'in excess of £2.5million'; a contract of exactly £2.5million is in row 4 by the band but not by the text, and row 3 stops at 'less than £2.5million'.
Where the relevant Threshold exceeds £500,000 (works, concessions, light touch), row 1 ('up to relevant Threshold': Service Director) overlaps rows 3-4 (Key Decision / Executive) and row 2 is empty.
Call-In and Forward Plan Part numbers are blank: 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)'.

Boundary values fall in no band: exactly £500,000 for works/concessions/light touch (B2 'less than £500,000', C 'Above £500,000'), and exactly the Threshold (B1/C 'less than the Threshold', D 'Above Threshold').
The *** footnote is defined but the *** marker is never used in the App B table (only *, ** and **** appear).
notes.quote: There are three different procurement regulation thresholds for:

notes.text: 1.4 lists four threshold types (Goods & Services, Works, Concession contracts, Light Touch) while the *** footnote lists three (Works and concession contracts combined). Separate WORKS and CONCESSIONS parameters are declared; they may share one figure.

Footnote ** says the Council cannot give preference to SME/VCSE or local suppliers, yet B1/B2 require inviting at least one of each 'where appropriate and possible'. Read as an invitation requirement only, not a preference in award.
notes.quote: The Council cannot give preference to SME/ VCSE or local contractors/suppliers

notes.text: 'Local supplier' is defined only in the local supplier policy, which is not in data/.
notes.quote: Refer to the local supplier policy for the definition.

notes.text: The circumstance text is garbled: 'no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken ... ; or' is missing a conjunction and ends with a dangling 'or'.
notes.quote: no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken

notes.text: Row E concerns variations of scope, but the above-Threshold route requires an 'extension report'.
notes.quote: an extension report to the relevant board

notes.text: A contract value exactly equal to the Threshold is neither 'below the Threshold' nor 'greater than the Threshold'.

notes.clause: App C note / App C row D
notes.text: The closing note ('where an exemption is applied') is read as applying to every Appendix C exclusion, so an above-Threshold extension under row D needs board approval as well as the S151 Officer's.
